_comment: V8 block-coverage ratchet for src/cql/endpoints.js, driven ONLY by the differential + completion batteries (see coverage-runner.js). 'minCovered' is a floor that moves UP only: a drop fails the ratchet test and names the newly-uncovered lines; a rise passes and prints a note to bump this number. Lowering it requires editing this file (a conspicuous, reviewable diff), usually alongside a new 'exclusions' entry. 'total'/'pct' are informational, not asserted. A Node major-version bump can shift V8 block granularity and require recomputing the baseline.

exclusions.reason: defensive head.kind==='identifier' guard; real statement heads always tokenize as keywords
exhaustive-switch fallthrough return [] — no real clause reaches it
standalone '.' punctuation only reachable via malformed tokenization
association target missing from the compiled model — not model-derivable
